title: Irish Vegan Pasta Bake
description: A comforting and flavorful vegan pasta bake with a hint of zesty spices, perfect for a satisfying meal. This dish is free from animal products and showcases a plant-based twist on a classic Irish dish.

ingredients.name: Irish vegan sausages
ingredients.notes: look for vegan sausages made from plant-based ingredients

ingredients.name: non-dairy milk
ingredients.notes: such as soy milk or almond milk

instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the Irish vegan sausages and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the zesty vegan pasta sauce to the skillet and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a simmer and let cook for 2-3 minutes.
In a large baking dish, combine the cooked pasta, sausages, and sauce. Stir to combine.
Pour the non-dairy milk over the pasta mixture and stir to combine.
Sprinkle the vegan mozzarella shreds over the top of the pasta mixture.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25-30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
